subject: Junior Civil Construction Estimator, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I'm based in Melton, so Melbourne is home ground, and estimating is where I want to build a career because it joins the drawings and the numbers.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, so reading drawings and specifications and turning them into quantities is familiar work. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, reviewing drawings, checking the work against them, tracking procurement and materials, and chasing pricing and deliveries with suppliers and subcontractors.

To be plain: I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so I'd be learning your tools and your rates from the junior end. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and I'm available to travel for remote works.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Jr Civil Construction Estimator
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I'm based in Melton, so Melbourne is home ground, and estimating is where I want to build a career: it is the part of civil work where the drawings and the numbers meet, and the ad's mix of take-offs, drawing review and supplier pricing is the work I want to learn properly.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities, alongside road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage designs that I drew in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides. Reading drawings and specifications and turning them into quantities of earthworks, concrete and drainage is familiar work from that study. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors to sort out pricing, deliveries and site issues. That gave me a feel for what a quantity becomes on site and how supplier pricing gets chased.

To be plain about the ad's list: I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so I'd be learning your tools and your rates from the junior end. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm available to travel for remote works.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the role.
